title: Park the primary checkout ON main when main is free (detach only as a fallback)
goal: park-primary.sh always detached the primary checkout because main was held by the old susi-main-integration worktree; that worktree is gone (main is PR-only now) and a human running 'git switch main' hit 'main is already used by worktree'. When no other worktree holds main, switch the primary checkout to main and fast-forward it to origin/main (refuse if main has local commits or work would be lost); detach at origin/main only when another worktree holds main. It must be a no-op when already on main at origin/main, so the next susi-worktree.sh never undoes a human's choice.
